skindar.name: Marl Skindar
skindar.title: Republic Intelligence Operative
skindar.description: A master spy masquerading as a corporate agent, buried so deep in cover that even allies forget who he really is.
skindar.philosophy: Information wins wars. Visibility gets you killed.
skindar.voiceStyle: Dry, impatient, dismissive. Always sounds like this assignment is beneath him.
skindar.values: Subtlety, competence, secrecy, survival through intelligence
skindar.tooltip: Skindar reflects your character through the lens of espionage and deniable power

levelGreetings.1: Welcome to the farce they call corporate espionage. Your cover is your first weapon.
levelGreetings.2: You survive the basics. Observation, asset management, subtlety. Don’t get comfortable.
levelGreetings.3: You’re picking up tradecraft faster than expected. I’m recalculating your usefulness.
levelGreetings.4: Blending in and manipulating outcomes—you do it well enough.
levelGreetings.5: Halfway to competence. Try not to embarrass me.
levelGreetings.6: Three successful infiltrations. Almost worth my time.
levelGreetings.7: Your reports are credible. High praise. Don’t get cocky.
levelGreetings.8: Senior operative level. Now don’t make me regret this.
levelGreetings.9: You’ve exceeded expectations. Don’t expect compliments.
levelGreetings.10: Master Corporate Agent. Go do your espionage—competently.

default: Shipyard's open. Bring me a frame or point at what you want tuned, and we'll get to it.
Every hull's got a story and a price tag. Let's see what yours needs.
noChanges: Nothing staged yet. Browse the systems bay when you're ready to spend credits.
Ship's sitting pretty as-is. Say the word when you want to change that.
stagedInstall: Hyperdrive, shields, weapons — whatever you're bolting on, make sure it earns its slot.
Cargo space or firepower, pick your trade-off. I've seen both get crews killed and both get crews rich.
Nice piece of hardware. Validate it before you commit — I don't cover buyer's remorse.
stagedRemoval: Pulling that off the frame. Resale goes back to whoever's paying — don't spend it twice.
Stripping parts is half of this business. The other half is not getting caught doing it.
blocked: That build's not street-legal as staged. Fix the conflict or enjoy explaining it to a customs inspector.
Engine's rejecting the combination. Something on that ship doesn't play nice together.
lowFunds: Wallet's short for this work order. Trim the list or find more credits — I don't run a tab.
That total's more than the account can cover. Pick your priorities.
ready: Clean build, no red flags. Apply it and let's see her fly.
Legal, funded, and ready. That's rarer than you'd think in this line of work.

guidance.class: Sharpen your cover and never stand out.
guidance.abilities: A steady hand and a sharper mind.
guidance.summary: If they notice you, you failed.
guidance.species: Your species shapes your potential. Choose what suits your path.
guidance.background: Your past defines you. Use it wisely.
guidance.forcePowers: Choose powers that strengthen your purpose.

tier1: I don’t tell stories. I solve problems.
tier2: If you’re doing this right, you forget your own name.
tier3: Every role I’ve played was true.
tier4: People who get noticed don’t last.
tier5: My real life is filed under classified.
